entries.prompt: Create an animation contact sheet of reference broom dokkaebi Mongdang. Exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 separate figures on transparent background. Every figure confined to central 60% of its own equal square cell with LARGE empty gutters all sides, no overlap, no text. All figures SAME direction: 11 o'clock, back facing viewer, facing upper left. Consistent small hand-painted tactical RPG sprite style, straw hair, wooden elderly face, green rags, straw skirt, broom weapon. Fixed camera and scale, identical foot baseline and body center. Row1 idle 4 phases breathing; Row2 walk in place 4 phases left foot forward, passing, right forward, passing; Row3 attack 4 phases windup, broom sweep, contact, return; Row4 magic cast 4 phases prepare, raise free hand, release wind, lower hand. No particles or shadows outside body; no scenery. Entire broom fits within each cell. Never show a neighboring figure inside a cell. Direction must remain 11 o'clock, back facing viewer, facing upper left in every frame, including walking and attacks.
